span.style: width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; background:#3fb950; box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(63,185,80,0.6); display:inline-block;

div.div: Designing the glue between models and reality — memory, skills, prompt orchestration and multi-agent workflows in the OpenCode ecosystem.
I ship open source. Tools, dotfiles, ML experiments, system configs. If it helps someone else build faster, it belongs in public.
